name: Chiralmori
source:
This is a fan disc of the Nitro+ Chiral characters, featuring 3 mini games. Various characters from Togainu no Chi and Lamento -Beyond the Void- are included.

[From [url=http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/cPath/30_45/products_id/9003]Himeya Shop[/url]]

Play poker against cute chibis of the Togainu cast, or test your typing speed with the furry-eared guys of Lamento. There's even a strange version of the Puyo Puyo falling-block game for you to enjoy.

[from [url=http://www.jbox.com/product/PCG1375]JBOX[/url]]
translation:
这是以Nitro+CHiRAL角色为主题的粉丝向附加光盘，收录三款迷你游戏。《咎狗之血》和《Lamento-BEYOND THE VOID-》中的多名角色都会登场。

[摘自[url=http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/cPath/30_45/products_id/9003]Himeya Shop[/url]]

你可以与《咎狗之血》的可爱Q版角色打扑克，也可以和《Lamento》里长着兽耳的男孩们比拼打字速度，甚至还能游玩一个奇怪版本的《噗哟噗哟》落物益智游戏。

[摘自[url=http://www.jbox.com/product/PCG1375]JBOX[/url]]
